verdict.rationale: The evidence shows fixed, built-in event-driven automation: Discord notifications on feedback, status sync with Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp and Asana, and Autopilot capturing feedback from sources automatically. Nothing shows that users can author their own trigger→action rules, so only a glancing part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: a user-configurable rules or automation builder, documented triggers and conditions, custom action definitions (e.g. webhooks or workflows), and independent corroboration.
